technical_checks.test: Strict Setup-v2/generated-start schema, current extents, material validity,1MiB budget,32768 stamps/rectangles and applicable native replay-work bounds.

Full native-size row-major uint8 replay by two independent implementations; exact-cell SHA256 and canonical rectangle round-trip; no resize, nearest-point substitution, cell sampling or image-only inference.

No out-of-bounds box/disc claims, invalid IDs or malformed rectangles. Report raw stamp overlaps separately from compact exported rectangle overlap. Final compact rectangles must partition exactly the nonempty cells.

Permanent support uses immovable hard cells with kernel/reactivity disclosed. Four-neighbour rooted components measured against original-declared anchor strips; bottom-boundary rooting also reported as a diagnostic. New unrooted architectural components are a regression unless an explicit intentional suspended fixture is predeclared.

Every liquid's connected footprint, gravity/lateral escape and boundary exposure tested against permanent barriers, with reactive containment limitations. All8 neighbour contact pairs audited; Acid exemptions exactly0,1,12; no new opposing/reactive contacts unless declared purpose requires them.
Image/grid parity uses unannotated1:1 preview plus documented palette/compositing. Crops/local claims must identify exact source rectangles. Beauty image alone never proves grid parity.

Extract every approved-original spawn and named destination coordinate before authoring, preserve exact coordinates, and separately test source declaration, output declaration, occupied centre and each complete actor envelope.

Four-neighbour exact-centre connectivity for19x15,23x19,31x27 rectangular envelopes against nonempty cells, plus native hard-surface-only sensitivity. Out-of-bounds footprint is blocked. A blocked exact centre remains blocked; never snap it to free space.

Consecutive ordered waypoint reachability and explicit path witness are required for a claimed route. Report shortest path lengths, envelope failures and optional safety margins. Plain connectivity is not proof of prescribed traversal.

Every obstruction claim identifies unchanged exact start/goal and blocked region. Compare before/blocked distances and path topology. A forced gallery claim requires that removing the gallery from traversable space disconnects the same endpoints, not just a longer route or a reachable gallery waypoint.

An alternative route claim requires distinct witnessed passages in the final exact cells and preserved endpoint connectivity; all named waypoints checked directly. A single open chamber with arbitrary different path drawings does not establish distinct authored routes.
Native install/actor motion/contact/physics/save/fresh-process reopen reported separately, tied to source/runtime/input hashes. Static pass remains explicitly static where these are absent.

regression_policy: Characterize every original first. Hard requirement is no introduced regression relative to that original under the same fixed tests. Inherited failures remain prominently reported; passing an intervention does not waive them or turn them into positive claims. A newly claimed repaired property must independently pass its own direct check.

artistic_criteria.name: identity
artistic_criteria.criterion: Preserve the original's specific silhouette, landmark hierarchy, material relationships and named site identity. Distinguish functional morphology from signs, recolouring or captions.

artistic_criteria.name: function
artistic_criteria.criterion: At1:1 cells and movement-relevant context, receiving/testing/dispatch/workface relationships must be readable through material-cell geometry and entered space. No requirement for machinery to animate unless claimed.

artistic_criteria.name: negative_space
artistic_criteria.criterion: Retain intentional voids, flyways, editing pockets and recovery air. Added detail must support the bounded repair without filling the source's useful emptiness.

artistic_criteria.name: topology
artistic_criteria.criterion: Preserve source route logic, unequal levels, separate chambers/crossings and recovery branches. Advertised choices must be distinguishable at the approach and remain exact-cell accessible.

artistic_criteria.name: diversity
artistic_criteria.criterion: Across the eight, preserve different spatial/material grammars and intervention scale. Do not flatten all maps into repeated frames, platforms, generic pads, signage or a shared repair motif.

art_rating_scale.0: Fails the stated identity/function or introduces a material regression
art_rating_scale.1: Claim largely depends on explanation; weak cell evidence
art_rating_scale.2: Partly legible or mixed, with a material caveat
art_rating_scale.3: Clearly supported at native cell scale and contextual view
art_rating_scale.4: Exceptionally clear and integrated while preserving source strengths

art_decision: Mandatory original P1 is resolved only with direct before/after evidence in the designated focus; average score cannot hide a remaining P1 or introduced regression. Controls must independently justify abstention. D1 original transfer label OBVIOUS is retained alongside experiment difficult-failure class.
blinding: First original/output visual comparison should conceal author labels and repair-reference identity where feasible. Disclose recognizable originals/familiarity; precommit files retain arm identity for provenance. Prior references remain sealed until all output hashes lock.
reference_authorship: Call later unsealed controls prior reworker references; distinct human authorship is unverified.
prohibitions: No repair-reference inspection before all-output lock
No hidden solutions transmitted to author
No engine edits, paid CI, remote mutations, Ready, merge, closures or automations
